newsitem.title: UK: IPE BRENT JUMPS OVER $19/BBL ON U.S. STRENGTH.
newsitem.headline: IPE BRENT JUMPS OVER $19/BBL ON U.S. STRENGTH.

text.p: IPE Brent crude futures shot over $19.00 a barrel on Wedneday in a technical response to a gasoline-inspired rally in U.S. crude futures, brokers said.
September IPE was trading at $19.10 a barrel at 18.07 GMT, five cents off the high, after a mainly humdrum session that ranged around $18.80 to $18.90.

The London rally response to a break above $20.00 a barrel by September WTI, which was trading later at $20.19 a barrel, six cents off the high. September gasoline was 1.89 cent higher at 65.60 a gallon.
"Crude is being lead by unleaded gasoline, which made a good response to the APIs," a broker said.
U.S. gasoline was also fired up by rumours of a snag of Exxon's Baytown catalytic cracker in Houston, Texas and news that Exxon was in the market buying product.
An Exxon source said Baytown was running its cracker after a leak but was considering a short shutdown for repairs.
The London crude rally saw October Brent smashing through chart resistance at $18.95.
